description: AEO scan. Any public domain in, an agent-readiness scorecard out, fetched live on the call: robots.txt with per-crawler AI access verdicts, content-signal lines, sitemap, llms.txt, landing metadata, markdown negotiation, and the well-known API catalog. Unreachable targets return their fetch outcomes as the result. Price: $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

domain.description: The public domain to scan for AI-answer readiness, e.g. example.com.

name: aeo-scan
